data_output.description: data.py remains unchanged and encode(splits) supplies each split as (features, labels, user_ids, row_ids), where features retain shape (n, 5) for the exact existing encoded user_id, video_id, tab, hour, and weekday fields. train.py must preserve source row order and must not use test labels.

model_input.description: Model.step receives train features of shape (n, 5), binary long_view labels, and exact user_ids for an intact group-complete minibatch; it optimizes all positive-negative RankNet pairs within each user only. Model.predict receives features and returns one finite score per row in input order.
